human_review.summary: Updated the live-search quickstart example to pass an invite code during first registration.
human_review.rationale: The baseline all-mode check flagged the bare register call as stale and the docs-fix regression could not prepare. README.md documents registration with invite_code, so the quickstart now matches the supported example. The post-edit truthfulness, links, and evals modes and git diff --check passed. A broader post-edit all-mode rerun timed out; the final validation records the targeted passing modes.
